assertions.assertion: Configures UseForwardedHeaders with ForwardedHeaders.XForwardedFor and ForwardedHeaders.XForwardedProto
assertions.rationale: UseForwardedHeaders is configured with ForwardedHeaders.XForwardedFor | ForwardedHeaders.XForwardedProto.

assertions.assertion: Places UseForwardedHeaders before UseAuthentication in the middleware pipeline
assertions.rationale: UseForwardedHeaders appears first, before UseRouting/UseAuthentication, and the text stresses it must precede authentication.

assertions.assertion: Configures UsePathBase('/app') for the sub-path mount
assertions.rationale: app.UsePathBase("/app") is included with an explanation of callback/management path resolution.

assertions.assertion: Mentions SameSite cookie configuration (Lax for cross-site IDP) as a potential contributing factor
assertions.rationale: It explains that a cross-site IdP needs SameSite=Lax and shows ConfigureCookies setting SameSiteMode.Lax.
